items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Well of course I did a lot of recording sessions in cooperation with Joe Merez. Some of them were mine, some of them were his.

ctx.x: Well, he must have heard several tones. There's another Harry Smith that I've heard of somewhere. Well, did you ever do any recording sessions in New Orleans?

Oh, yeah, of course. Well of course I did a lot of recording sessions in cooperation with Joe Merez. Some of them were mine, some of them were his. And I think I recall that you were present at some of the sessions. I think you were at Woodman of the World Hall when we made the Kingsville Parade with Johnny Wiggs and Raymond Burke and Emil Christian, Jeff Riddick, Paul Barberan, Sherwood Mangiapani.

I came to the Woodman of the World for the dances, and I think I was there for the recording session. I think you were. Those two things get mixed up in my mind. We were talking about that once and how you didn't have the same personnel.
